contribution_requirements: Mobile-only changes. Every screen wires ONLY through src/api/* typed functions — NEVER a raw fetch in app/. Reuse BigButton and PersonCard; add small shared components only if needed. Honor the HARD product constraint (docs/PRODUCT.md): activity is reported as ENGAGEMENT (played vs skipped counts), NEVER a score/rating/percentage/accuracy/cognitive measure. Keep existing (caregiver) route/file names; replace placeholder bodies in place.
key_patterns: Screens use useTheme() from src/theme-context, SafeAreaView + ScrollView/FlatList, and three async states: loading (ActivityIndicator), error (catch `instanceof ApiError`, show err.message + retry), empty (friendly message). The client (src/api/client.ts) already injects X-Role and X-Caregiver-Id from AsyncStorage — screens never set them. ApiError has kind: 'config'|'network'|'timeout'|'http' and optional status (404 == backend module still a stub; 403 == access denied). SQLite booleans are numbers 0|1 (is_caregiver, is_quiet_period, is_active). All enum pickers/toggles map to the exact string unions in src/types.ts — never free-type an enum or a recurrence string. Photos resolve via PersonCard using hubUrl from getHubUrl(). Existing app/ screens import src with relative paths (../../src/...); stay consistent (the @/* alias exists but is unused in app/).
